name: Volunteer Program (ages 14 and up)
what_you_do: Volunteers can help with camps, field trips, exhibits, animal care, the planetarium, the front desk and events. You get free entry after 10 hours and a free membership after 50 hours.
who_can_apply: Age 14 or older (some roles need 18). Must sign a liability waiver and complete a background check.
pay_detail: Volunteer, unpaid. Membership perks after 10, 50 and 100 hours.
how_to_apply: Call 540-342-5718 or email hsell@smwv.org. The contact is Hunter Sell, Director of Operations.
notes: The page is not teen specific. Ask how the background check works for minors.
